source_text: Mundum quod ungulam findit et ruminat. Ruminatio — meditatio legis; ungula fissa — discretio operum. Utrumque require.
pass_a_gloss: Clean what hoof splits and chews-cud. Cud-chewing — meditation of-law; hoof split — discernment of-works. Both require.
pass_b_english: Clean is what [[parts the hoof and chews the cud >> Bible:Leviticus 11:3]]. Cud-chewing is meditating the law; the split hoof is discerning works. Require both.
